permissions.name: payouts:connect
permissions.description: Connect your own payout account so other people can pay you, see its status and your charges, and open your Stripe dashboard

permissions.name: payouts:view
permissions.description: See every connected payout account, every charge made to one, and the fees the site has collected

permissions.name: payouts:refund
permissions.description: Refund a charge made to somebody's payout account, with or without the site's fee

permissions.name: payouts:settings
permissions.description: Change the fee, the fee cap, the countries payouts are offered in and the Connect webhook secret

settings.name: fee_percent
settings.description: The site's fee on each payment to a user, as a percentage of it. 0 takes no fee. Up to two decimal places, less than 100

settings.name: fee_cap
settings.description: The most fee the site takes from one recipient for one reference (an event, say), in the smallest unit of the site's currency — 5000 is $50.00. 0 means no cap

settings.name: allowed_countries
settings.description: Two-letter country codes, comma-separated, that recipients may connect from. Empty means every country Stripe supports for this. It can only narrow Stripe's list

settings.name: connect_webhook_secret
settings.description: Signing secret (whsec_…) of the Stripe webhook endpoint that listens to events on connected accounts. Without it no account ever becomes ready and no payment to a user is ever confirmed

groups.name: kempo-payouts:viewer
groups.description: Can see connected payout accounts, charges to them and the fees collected, but change nothing

groups.name: kempo-payouts:administrator
groups.description: Everything a viewer can do, plus refunding charges and changing the fee and Connect settings
